identityReview: Marissa Ann Mayer, American engineer, former Yahoo CEO and founder of Dazzle, matched across Stanford, Walmart, AT&T and company sources. Distinct from novelist Marissa Meyer. Birth year 1975 follows Wikipedia identity section; not inferred from age.
lifeStatusEvidence: NPR interview published November 2, 2026 quotes Mayer discussing Dazzle and personal AI assistance. Interview publication is dated recent activity evidence, not a verified recording date.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read sources recorded in research checkpoint, supplemented with AT&T 2026 SEC proxy biography and original Sunshine release date header.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, degrees, early Google employment and product work, Yahoo appointment and departure, Sunshine founding/debut distinction, Dazzle founding and launch, current board roles and recent interview.
corrections: Birth year 1975 is secondary-source evidence. Stanford degrees are symbolic systems bachelor and computer science master; IIT engineering doctorate is honorary. Graduation years not added without verification.

Stanford contemporaneous January 2003 seminar dates Google entry to June 1999. CHM confirms Associate Product Manager program founding but does not date it precisely; no inferred 2002 founding year. Product achievements are team contributions, not sole inventions.
CHM January 2012 event footer contains a later-updated Lumi Labs biography; this does not establish Lumi Labs existed in 2012.
Yahoo appointment announced July 16, 2012 took effect July 17. President, CEO and director are separate concurrent roles.
Verizon June 13, 2017 release confirms acquisition of Yahoo operating business and Mayer resignation. It does not describe purchase of every Yahoo asset. Tim Armstrong, not Mayer, led Oath.

Sunshine CEO tenure began in 2018 according to Walmart and AT&T. November 18, 2020 release marks public debut and first app, not initial company creation. Enrique Muñoz Torres was cofounder/president; Mayer cofounder/CEO. Initial US iPhone invitation access is historical, not a present availability assertion.

AT&T 2026 proxy explicitly dates Dazzle founding to September 2025 and says Sunshine was acquired in 2025. No precise acquisition closing date or legal asset structure inferred. Public product launch on September 29, 2026 is a separate event.
Walmart biography still describes Dazzle as stealth; official September 2026 launch supersedes that wording. Current Dazzle founder/CEO role is corroborated by company and proxy biographies.
Walmart, AT&T, Hilton and Starbucks board roles do not imply operating executive appointments. Former Nextdoor directorship ended June 2025 according to Walmart and AT&T; not listed as current.

NPR November 2, 2026 interview supports dated activity. Product is described as for everyone, not women-only. Claimed product functions are attributed, not independently tested. Transcript audio-authority notice acknowledged; audio not separately audited.
sourceReview.limits: AI authorship and semantic review, not human/native-language certification. Birth year uses secondary source. No unverified graduation dates, exact acquisition close date or independent product performance claims.
